changeSet.author: lifefit
changeSet.comment: LF-0044: Mark premium AI features as user-scoped so they consume a LifeFit app plan seat.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE app.FeatureDefinitions SET Scope = N'User', ConsumesLicense = 1, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE Code IN (N'AI_COACH', N'AI_WORKOUT_GENERATION', N'AI_NUTRITION', N'AI_PROGRESS_INSIGHTS') AND DeletedAt IS NULL;

rollback.sql: UPDATE app.FeatureDefinitions SET Scope = N'Tenant', ConsumesLicense = 0, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE Code IN (N'AI_COACH', N'AI_WORKOUT_GENERATION', N'AI_NUTRITION', N'AI_PROGRESS_INSIGHTS') AND DeletedAt IS NULL;
